name: talents_page
sql: SELECT id, name, status FROM talents WHERE is_deleted=0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20

name: talents_deep_offset
sql: SELECT id, name FROM talents WHERE is_deleted=0 ORDER BY id DESC LIMIT 20 OFFSET 10000

name: matching_records_by_position
sql: SELECT * FROM matching_records WHERE position_id=1 ORDER BY created_at DESC LIMIT 20

name: analytics_distribution
sql: SELECT education, count(*) FROM dim_talent_wide GROUP BY education

name: analytics_trend
sql: SELECT snapshot_month, count(*) FROM fact_talent_snapshot GROUP BY snapshot_month ORDER BY snapshot_month
